purpose: Dependency-first, evidence-gated build control. Dates are targets; dependencies and CHECK evidence determine executable order.

selectionLaw.rule: Select only items whose dependencies are PASS and whose status is READY or LOOP with an earned next seed. WAITING on an external I does not block unrelated READY work.
selectionLaw.promotion: No item becomes PASS from Maker/self-reported evidence alone; an independent CHECK must cite observed evidence.
selectionLaw.authority: Roadmap priority never grants execution authority. Execution still requires catalog resolution, grants, validated resources, and governance.

privacyLaw.privateRuntime: Private desktop runtime implementation may provide execution/check evidence but is never copied into distributable marketplace artifacts.
privacyLaw.publicEvidence: Publish contracts, versions, hashes, verdicts, and bounded evidence; do not publish credentials, private runtime source, private trails, or customer data.
